INTRODUCING THE FLOW EVOLUTION OF CHAT

Cascade

Cascade combines deep codebase understanding, a breadth of advanced tools, and a real-time awareness of your actions into a powerful, seamless, and collaborative flow. It is the most powerful way to code with AI.

Full contextual awareness

Deep contextual awareness allows you to run Cascade on production codebases and still get relevant suggestions.

Tab Tab Tab...Ship

A single keystroke, limitless power, complete flow. The full power of Windsurf Tab is exclusive to the Windsurf Editor. Our IDE plugins include only the autocomplete action.

Linter Integration

Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Enhance your AI workflows by connecting to custom tools and services

Tab to Jump

Predicts the next location of your cursor to seamlessly navigate through the file

Supercomplete

Supercomplete analyzes what your next action might be, beyond just inserting the next code snippet

In-line Command + Follow ups

Press Cmd + I in your editor to generate or refactor in-line code using natural language

Command in Terminal

Press Cmd + I in terminal and type in terminal instructions in natural language

Codelenses

Highlighted code actions

You can directly mention highlighted code in the Cascade panel or refactor it using Command

@ mentions in Cascade

Refer to your functions, classes, files or entire directories to guide Cascade to relevant context

Windsurf powers mission-critical systems and accelerates software development for the world’s leading companies.

The Original Launch

An AI-native editor built from the beginning to understand software development, customize to your unique work, and become your perfect pair programmer.

Case Study Testimonials

We are pleased to induct Windsurf into the JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation. Windsurf has demonstrated a novel approach to generative AI for software development, enabling our developers to quickly become productive on new and heritage codebases, iterate on new capabilities, and focus on delivering business value.

Sandhya Sridharan

Global Head of Engineers’ Platform & Integrated Experience, JPMorgan Chase

Speed and trust are everything to us. As we continue to expand our platform and operations, we’re investing in tools that help our teams work more efficiently and sustainably.

We adopted the Windsurf Editor as part of our strategy to support developer productivity and streamline how we build at scale. We are excited to see how this collaboration can help us move faster while maintaining the technical excellence our users expect.

Oscar Mullin

VP of Data, GenAI & Infrastructure, Mercado Libre

We work with highly critical systems and sensitive information that must be protected to safeguard the lives of patients being treated by physicians. At athenahealth, we take a rigorous approach to every technology decision. With Windsurf, we uphold our standards and empower our teams to build quickly.

Jeremy Luallen

Director of R&D Productivity, athenahealth

Our code is important to us, and often strictly confidential, so SaaS solutions like GitHub Copilot and others were not viable options. We considered making our own generative AI model within our environment, but when we found Codeium (Windsurf), it was like seeing a big red 'easy' button.

Cy Sack

Head of Business Systems, Anduril

I am super excited for the incredible value we can get from AI-assisted code generation. Our main goal is to turbocharge developer productivity and output.

Souvik Das

CTO, Clearwater Analytics

Implementing Codeium (Windsurf) Enterprise in our environment was straightforward and seamless, and it immediately boosted our productivity by providing indispensable daily coding support to our developers. All while safeguarding our intellectual property and getting better results than competitor products.

Filip Viskovic

Developer Experience Team Lead, DRW
